newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index edges higher on Slovnaft gains.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index edges higher on Slovnaft gains.

text.p: 1530 - Slovak SAX index edges higher pushed by gains to oil refinery Slovnaft in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Friday.
* Slovnaft up 15 crowns at 925, VSZ up one crown at 698, VUB Bank down 44 crowns at 1,716, Nafta down 30 at 1,670.
* Overall volume 421,571 shares, turnover 623.15 million crowns.
The Slovak SAX index closed up 0.26 points to 202.21, pushed by gains to oil refinery Slovnaft in moderate trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday.
Brokers said the market appeared to be in bullish mood with potential for further growth.
"Although the index now seems to be rising by only small steps, the atmosphere on the bourse is quite optimistic," Libor Briska of Creditanstalt said.
"Some of the biggest issues have potential for futher rises, which could boost the overall market again," he said.
Slovnaft closed up 15 crowns to 925, with 850 shares traded.
"We see the investors' interest in Slovnaft also at this current price level," Briska said. "It still has room for a rise."

The most heavily traded share was steel maker VSZ issue, which closed up one crown to 698. "A good sign was that the entire volume in VSZ was traded in continuous trading, without the blocks," Briska said.
Overall volume eased to 421,571 shares, from 519,643 shares traded on Thursday, while turnover rose to 623.15 million crowns, from 435.88 million.
